title: Paying a Decided Claim on a Travel Protection Policy
content:
Where the insurer has decided a claim on a policy of the Travel Protection Plans and allowed money on it,
that money is paid to the policyholder, and the payment consumes that much of the policy's benefit for the rest
of its term. The payment is made in the currency the premium was paid in.

## Conditions on the payment

The money paid on a decided claim is worked out only after the policy's claim record carries the recovery owed
for every compensation a liable third party has paid the traveller on a settlement already made under this
policy.

A payment is released on a decided claim only once every benefit the same incident has touched stands filed on
the policy, because one incident is settled as one case.

## How the write is made

The desk unlocks the agency-side tool `release_claim_payment_9edda418` and calls it. One call adds a payment row
to the policy's claim record: it carries the money actually paid, the deductible withheld from it, the date the
payment was authorised, the benefit it was paid under and the decision it settles, and it marks the claim paid.
What the policyholder sees afterwards is the settled amount standing paid against their claim reference.

## The parameters

| Parameter | What it is |
|---|---|
| `care_policy_id` | The reference number of the travel protection policy the payment is made under, read from the policy record found for the traveller |
| `source_claim_id` | The reference number of the decision row this payment settles, read from the claim record of that policy |
| `claim_reference` | The reference the insurer quoted for the claim being paid, copied character for character from the claim record, keeping the original wording, digits and punctuation, with no translation, normalisation, summarisation, addition or deletion |
| `claim_type` | The benefit the payment is made under; exactly one of the eleven heads below and never any other word |
| `paid_amount_usd` | The money actually paid to the policyholder on this settlement, given as a USD amount with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent |
| `deductible_applied_usd` | The deductible withheld from this settlement, given as a USD amount with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent; 0.00 where nothing is withheld |

The eleven heads `claim_type` accepts are `trip_cancellation`, where the journey was called off before it began;
`trip_interruption`, where a journey already begun was cut short or broken into; `medical_emergency`, where the
traveller was treated for illness or injury away from home; `dental_emergency`, where the treatment was dental;
`evacuation`, where the traveller had to be moved or repatriated for medical reasons; `baggage_delay`, where
checked baggage reached the traveller late; `baggage_loss`, where baggage or an article in it was lost or
damaged outright; `travel_delay`, where the traveller themselves was held up in transit; `missed_connection`,
where a late arrival caused an onward service to be missed; `rental_damage`, where a hired vehicle was damaged;
and `cancel_for_any_reason`, where the journey was called off for a reason no other head covers.

## What comes back

A plain-text confirmation naming the reference number minted for the payment row, the policy and claim reference
it settles, the amount paid and the deductible withheld. Receiving that confirmation is what indicates the
payment has been made and the benefit consumed; nothing else is returned.
